name: Brainrot Camo Troll Tower
desc:
Welcome to Brainrot Camo Troll Tower!

😈Camo as a wall and troll your friends 
🔴Watch out for trolls camouflaged!

Find the italian brainrots hidden to get new slap hands!

🌱Grow A Garden
🌟Steal A Brainrot
😂 Troll Tower
